mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversations (tenant_id, conversation_id, user_id, title, conversation_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{conversationStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), conversation_status = VALUES(conversation_status), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_conversations WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
